subsystems.drivetrain: Swerve; centering wedges extend over module areas.

subsystems.transfer: Two-roller feeder can reverse into the backpack path.
subsystems.scoring: Sector-gear pivot with steel reinforcement; asymmetrical wheel arrangement adds spin.

subsystems.controls: Four Limelights localize; absolute pivot sensing controls shot angle.

versions: Powered/pliant cap geometry evolved to handle both amp and trap angles; Open Alliance thread supplies the longer development history.
dossier.analysis: This is an especially useful source for how packaging, service access and control states develop together. The U-turn note path solves two destinations but must tolerate different release angles.

context_documents.title: 2024-3847 · Centering, spin and reverse transfer share one constrained path
context_documents.body:
# 2024-3847: Centering, spin and reverse transfer share one constrained path

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

Silicone-wrapped collector rollers, Teflon-covered wedges and additional module guides center the note. A two-roller feeder can reverse it into the backpack amp/trap path. Asymmetric black-wheel placement produces spin, while the main scoring pivot uses sector gearing with reinforcement.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The team explicitly identifies the full-width intake with driver margin and the contact materials with centering. The backpack receives the note through a reversed feed sequence.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

Forward and reverse transport must both control a flexible ring. A low-friction wedge is useful for centering but may provide little retention while the robot reverses direction or lifts the note. The launcher’s intended asymmetry also depends on repeatable centering. A shared path saves hardware only if direction changes do not create a high jam or alignment burden.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Test reversed handoffs after aggressive pickup, measure note pose before each route, and verify chain clearance through the climb/backpack sequence.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.

source_reviews.title: Spectrum 2024 season build log
source_reviews.locator: Belton and Houston event recaps, days 62–64 and Houston Upgrades
source_reviews.review_basis: Read team event and development text
facts: At Belton, a deformed top roller trapped a note against a blocker. Misfeeds also turned notes upright. The team replaced the roller and used eject/re-intake during matches.
Amp/trap gearbox tilted and jammed. A fastener at the bearing location stopped the cantilever in the reported fix.
Houston changes include new rollers, metal intake gearbox, steel launcher sector, vision launch and a revised climber.
source_reviews.limitations: Some sections discuss practice robot and 8515 Photon. Only 3847 competition robot observations are used as installed facts. Electrical root cause was unresolved.

source_review.whole_robot_explanation: Ultraviolet combines floor capture, a variable-angle launcher and a separate route for amp/trap. The team's event notes are especially informative because they show different failures of a piece that rotates inside a constrained path. One note wedged beside a deformed roller, and others flipped upright during feeding. The alternate scorer also failed when its gearbox moved out of line. Those incidents make the key interface clear. A roller or gear can still rotate freely in isolation while the assembled robot can no longer pass a note through the intended route.
piece_flow: Capture feeds the note past an intake roller and front blocker into the internal path. Belton reports show the path depends on keeping the ring horizontal.
The older dossier describes the primary launcher and a transfer up to amp/trap. The team reports changing the operator climb sequence to automate the secondary feed.
Houston changes included vision-based launch, a refined amp/trap system and a redesigned climber to improve reach over the lower trap lip.
source_review.packaging_and_motion: The upper intake roller, blocker and front chassis should be drawn with clearance for a bent roller and a skewed ring, as both can occur together. Keep the alternate gearbox supported against reaction torque. The release path changes as the chassis hangs, so the Houston trap work should be evaluated with the lip and chain present. A successful unloaded move is weak evidence for the combined loaded pose.

subsystems.name: Intake and blocker
subsystems.construction: Build log describes intake rollers and a polycarbonate front-rail blocker. Houston added rollers and a metal gearbox.
subsystems.operation: Pass a floor note toward the launcher while keeping it horizontal.
subsystems.team_rationale: Team wanted to remove known jams and intake failures between events.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: A blocker can prevent one wrong path while creating a pinch point next to a deflected roller. Observe the piece and the mechanism together under failure, including the note's tendency to spring upright.
subsystems.interfaces: Roller straightness, blocker height and entry guide position determine the allowed shape of the path.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Replacement solved one observed jam. Eject/re-intake was an in-match recovery for vertical notes. Verify it after a bent roller as well.
subsystems.unknowns: As-built gap, added flap installation and quantitative jam rate.

subsystems.name: Launcher and aiming
subsystems.construction: Team reports a launcher sector change to steel and a move to vision-based launching for Houston.
subsystems.operation: Set launch angle and use target localization for the shot.
subsystems.team_rationale: Steel change follows reported tooth damage. Vision was logged at Belton while still under evaluation.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: Moving to vision after data collection lets the team isolate pose changes from mechanical shot behavior. A steel sector can resist tooth damage while moving shock into another drive component.
subsystems.interfaces: Sector support, launcher structure and localization share responsibility for the actual shot angle and heading.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Inspect tooth contact and angle calibration after impacts. Replay poor camera conditions before assuming vision improved every shot.
subsystems.unknowns: Pitch tolerance, exact active cameras, current data and hit distributions.

subsystems.name: Secondary scorer and chain
subsystems.construction: Team reports a separate amp/trap gearbox with bearing support and redesigned climber for higher trap clearance.
subsystems.operation: Transfer to the placement path, engage chain and position the note above the lip.
subsystems.team_rationale: The team identified a tilted gearbox and need for higher access.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: A fastener added at the bearing can control torque reaction that previously cantilevered the transmission. Extra height is only useful if the chassis hangs at the expected angle and the piece stays under control.
subsystems.interfaces: Gearbox support, stage lip and chain load all affect the release.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Inspect the bearing support and test under side load. Attempt piece recovery with the robot in the loaded fixture.
subsystems.unknowns: Exact loaded geometry, field success and final revision details.

revisions: Belton exposed intake and placement failures. Houston list identifies distinct mechanical, camera, launch and climb changes. Practice-machine and Photon failures remain separate.
transferable_principles: Use event fault reports to trace each jam to contact and support geometry. Validate repairs with a live piece path and representative loaded pose.
disconfirming_conditions: A guide change is ineffective if roller deflection still closes the exit. Vision targeting transfers poorly if camera visibility under defense cannot support the revised launch workflow.
remaining_gaps: Release CAD/code paths, event-specific sensor and mechanism geometry, primary interview captions and complete electrical diagnosis.
